name: Taiping Half Marathon 2026
short_description: The Taiping Half Marathon 2026 is a 5km/10km/21.1km race held on 9 August 2026 at Dataran Warisan, Taiping, Perak, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Taiping Half Marathon 2026 takes place on 9 August 2026 at Dataran Warisan in Taiping, Perak, Malaysia. Runners can choose from 5km, 10km, or 21.1km distances, with registration currently open and prices ranging from RM45 to RM110. It offers a range of distance options suited to different runner levels within the same event.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, 21.1km) suit different runner levels
Affordable price range from RM45 to RM110

faqs.question: When is the Taiping Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Taiping Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on 9 August 2026. The event will be held at Dataran Warisan in Taiping, Perak, Malaysia, giving participants a set date well in advance to plan their travel and training schedules accordingly.

faqs.question: What distance options are available?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Taiping Half Marathon 2026 can choose between three distances: 5km, 10km, and 21.1km, with the 21.1km half marathon serving as the primary distance. This variety allows runners of different experience levels and fitness goals to take part in the same event.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Registration fees for the Taiping Half Marathon 2026 range from RM45 to RM110, depending on the chosen distance and registration category. This pricing structure makes the event accessible to a range of participants, from casual runners in shorter distances to serious half marathon competitors.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Taiping Half Marathon 2026 is currently open. Prospective participants can sign up now for any of the three available distances—5km, 10km, or 21.1km—ahead of the race day on 9 August 2026 at Dataran Warisan, Perak.
